_about: From the first seconds of the Pop Up Text sample: keep the original talking-head frame, place very large condensed yellow words in the open space above the speaker, and use a person matte where the words pass behind the head or shoulders. Reveal words on speech with a short blur-to-sharp pop and use a small white handwritten bridge sparingly. Hide small subtitles while the same words appear as the main title. Adapt placement to the source face and background.
